ai_language_tip: Default to clear Singapore-friendly English (en); switch to Mandarin (cmn) at Chinese restaurants, TCM, or workshops if preferred; Malay/Tamil at community shops.
english_ok: often — English is the working language across businesses, clinics, and public agencies.
politeness: Polite, brisk, and practical; open with 'Hi/Hello' and purpose directly; Singlish terms like 'pax' or 'dabao' may be heard; end with 'Thank you, bye'.
name_tip: Surname with Mr/Ms (Mr Tan, Ms Lim) or first name works for dining; clinics and hotels ask full official name and spelling.
phone_tip: 8-digit numbers (mobile 8123 4567 or 9123 4567, landline 6123 4567) read 4-4; 0 as 'zero' or 'oh'; confirmations via WhatsApp or SMS.
time_tip: 12-hour AM/PM in speech ('7 PM', '7:30 PM'), 24-hour in clinic/gov SMS; avoid UK 'half seven', always state exact 'seven thirty PM'.
number_tip: Fast Singlish cadence clips final consonants ('fif-teen' vs 'fif-ty'); repeated digits spoken as 'double eight' or 'triple two'.
avoid_calling: Avoid F&B peak 12:00–13:30 and 18:30–20:00; clinic lunch closures 12:30/13:00–14:00; Muslim-owned shops during Friday prayers (12:30–14:00) and Ramadan iftar.
closed_days: Many neighborhood clinics close Sunday and weekday afternoons; hawkers rest Mondays or Tuesdays; Chinese New Year sees multi-day closures at Chinese businesses.
booking_channels: Chope, SevenRooms, Oddle, and inline/Google Reserve dominate dining; HealthHub for public polyclinics; WhatsApp Business widely used by salons and trades.
voice_menu: Public hospitals, polyclinics, banks, telcos (Singtel/StarHub), Town Councils, and airlines use keypad IVR and Singpass verification.
callback_habits: Automated SMS or WhatsApp confirmation links are standard; upscale restaurants send Chope/SevenRooms reconfirmation or deposit links.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 商場熱門餐廳多走 Chope 或 SevenRooms 線上留卡號保證，部分平價小店與熟食中心不接受訂位。
usually_asked: Date and dining time ('what time, which day')
Number of pax including adults, kids, and baby chair ('how many pax')
Indoor air-con vs outdoor/alfresco seating
Surname or name and 8-digit mobile number
Dining time limit acknowledgment (usually 90 mins peak)

may_come_up.what: Directs caller to Chope or online link for instant booking
Sends SMS link requiring credit card hold or deposit for 5+ pax
Offers first or second dinner seating window (e.g. 6:00 or 8:15 PM)

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card details over phone for no-show hold
Demands immediate PayNow transfer during call

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 政府綜合診療所（Polyclinic）須透過 HealthHub 預約；私人家庭診所（GP）與牙醫可電話約但常問身分證號。
usually_asked: New or existing patient at this clinic branch
Reason for visit (GP consult, dental scaling, vaccination, MC)
Patient full name as on ID
Preferred date, session (morning/afternoon/night), and doctor
Contact mobile number

may_come_up.what: GP clinic says walk-in queue only, no fixed time slots
Asks whether using corporate panel insurance (MHC/Fullerton/CHAS)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks for NRIC/FIN number (full or last 4 chars) or date of birth
Asks for insurance membership card number

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 多數美甲、美睫與SPA對新客可能要求 PayNow 訂金保留時段。
usually_asked: Service type (cut/color, gelish removal + manicure, massage)
Preferred date and time
First-time trial customer or existing package holder
Preferred stylist or therapist
Name and mobile number for WhatsApp reminder

may_come_up.what: Festive surcharge applies during pre-Chinese New Year period
Salon offers to send WhatsApp message for design photos

sensitive_asked.what: Requests immediate PayNow deposit ($20–$50) to confirm slot

repair.before_dialing_zh: 授權維修中心（如Apple、原廠車廠）多需線上預約或有語音選單；工業區車行（Ubi/Sin Ming）與手機店可直撥。
usually_asked: Car make/model and registration plate, or device model
Exact fault, warning light, or servicing package needed
Preferred drop-off date and time
Estimated turnaround or parts availability check
Customer name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Workshop asks car plate number (e.g. SBA1234X) to check parts
Quotes diagnostic fee waived only if proceeding with repair

sensitive_asked.what: Requests device passcode over the phone
Demands PayNow deposit to order special-order part

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 連鎖品牌多用 GrabFood、Oddle 或官網預付；煮炒（Zi Char）與傳統餐館常接受電話訂餐自取（dabao）。
usually_asked: Takeaway self-collection ('dabao') and branch confirmation
Dish names, sizes (small/medium/large), and less-spicy notes
Pickup time (usually 15–30 mins)
Name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Charges $0.30–$0.50 per takeaway container
Item out of stock and offers alternative dish

sensitive_asked.what: Requires immediate PayNow payment before preparing large order

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 大型連鎖零售常轉總機客服，獨立花店、烘焙坊與專賣店可電話查現貨並短暫留貨。
usually_asked: Exact item, model, flavor, or size
Quantity and outlet location
Same-day collection time
Name and contact number

may_come_up.what: Holds unpaid item only until end of business day
Out of stock at outlet; offers transfer from another branch

sensitive_asked.what: Requires PayNow payment to confirm custom cake or pre-order

change.before_dialing_zh: 若原本在 Chope 或付了訂金的平台上預訂，逾時取消可能會扣訂金或需在原連結操作。
usually_asked: Name and 8-digit mobile number under original booking
Original date and time
Reschedule target slot or cancellation request
Updated pax count if applicable

may_come_up.what: Within 24-hour cancellation window with penalty policy
Instructs owner to modify directly via SMS/Chope link

sensitive_asked.what: Asks for OTP or card digits to process refund

usually_asked: Specific question (walk-in wait time, halal status, corkage, pet-friendly)
Intended arrival time and group size
Outdoor area availability if bringing dog
Whether caller wants to leave name on waitlist or reserve

may_come_up.what: Corkage fee or cake-cutting fee applies
Offers to book table right away

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 多數星級飯店總機有按鍵分機且轉訂房組，通常官網或訂房網價格較優並需信用卡擔保。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates
Number of adults and children
Room category and bed configuration
Primary guest full name, email, and mobile number

may_come_up.what: IVR menu requires pressing digit for Reservations
Offers sending email payment/guarantee link instead of phone card

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number and expiry to guarantee room
Asks passport or NRIC number during reservation

activity.before_dialing_zh: 公立運動場（ActiveSG）與多數體驗課皆須線上預付，KTV（Teo Heng等）、高爾夫練習場與包場可電話約。
usually_asked: Outlet branch and room/court/activity type
Date, start time, and number of hours
Number of pax
Contact name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Public sports halls (ActiveSG) only book via MyActiveSG app
Peak weekend package or minimum hours required

sensitive_asked.what: Demands immediate PayNow deposit to lock room/lane

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須提供完整地址與郵遞區號（6位數），公寓（Condo）常需提前向保安登記車牌。
usually_asked: Service type (aircon servicing/chemical wash, plumbing, locksmith) and unit count
6-digit Singapore postal code, block/condo name, and unit number
HDB flat, condo, or landed property type
Preferred date and morning/afternoon window
Contact name and WhatsApp number

may_come_up.what: Standard normal wash vs chemical overhaul pricing difference
Technician requests photos of fault/aircon label via WhatsApp

sensitive_asked.what: Asks digital door lock PIN or condo access code
Demands deposit via PayNow before scheduling visit

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫、寵物美容與寄宿皆需預約，寄宿必查疫苗紀錄。
usually_asked: Service (vet consult, basic/full grooming, daycare/boarding)
Dog/cat breed, weight, age, and sterilization status
Up-to-date vaccination and tick/flea prevention status
Preferred date and slot
Owner name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Requires pre-boarding temperament assessment trial day
De-matting surcharge may apply upon inspection

sensitive_asked.what: Requests PayNow deposit for grooming/boarding slot

tracking.before_dialing_zh: SingPost、Ninja Van、Shopee 等大型物流熱線多為按鍵語音或線上機器人，獨立商家或車行進度才好打。
usually_asked: Tracking number, invoice number, or job sheet number
Recipient/customer name and contact number
6-digit delivery postal code for verification
Issue details (missed delivery, repair readiness)

may_come_up.what: Automated IVR requires keypad input or redirects to WhatsApp bot
Asks permission to leave parcel at riser or doorstep

sensitive_asked.what: Requests delivery OTP PIN over phone

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行、SP水電與航空公司客服皆需按鍵選單並核對 NRIC、生日或 Singpass，AI 無法代辦帳戶業務。
usually_asked: IVR menu keypad selection
Confirmation that caller is account holder in person
NRIC/FIN and date of birth for PDPA verification
Account or reference number

may_come_up.what: Strict PDPA policy blocks third-party assistant without written mandate
Cannot navigate keypad-only IVR tree

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NRIC/FIN, date of birth, card digits, or OTP

transport.before_dialing_zh: 一般叫車多用 Grab、Gojek 或 CDG Zig App；電話主要用於機場大車接送（MaxiCab）或租車公司。
usually_asked: Pickup date, time, and 6-digit postal code or terminal
Drop-off destination
Number of passengers and large luggage count
Vehicle type (6/7-seater MaxiCab, 13-seater minibus, rental model)
Passenger name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Midnight surcharge or ERP/airport waiting policy explained
Asks flight number for Changi Airport arrival pickup

sensitive_asked.what: Demands immediate PayNow deposit to confirm MaxiCab
Car rental requests NRIC or driving license number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: 新加坡租屋仲介幾乎都會詢問租客國籍/准證類型、入住人數與起租日以符合 HDB/URA 規定。
usually_asked: Property project name or PropertyGuru listing reference
Preferred viewing date and time
Number of tenants, relationship/family profile, and occupation
Target move-in date and lease duration (1 or 2 years)
Pets or cooking habits

may_come_up.what: Agent asks tenant residency/pass type for HDB quota check
Agent prefers continuing on WhatsApp to send floorplan/video

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NRIC/FIN number or work pass serial number before viewing
Requests booking deposit before physical viewing (scam risk)

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 政府機關熱線多有語音按鍵且個資須本人 Singpass 驗證；私立幼兒園（Preschool）預約參觀則很歡迎電話。
usually_asked: Nature of inquiry or preschool center tour request
Child age/level (Infant Care, Playgroup, N1–K2) if preschool
Preferred center branch and tour date/time
Parent/caller name and contact number

may_come_up.what: Government hotline requires keypad IVR or Singpass login online
Preschool waitlists full until next term; offers waitlist entry

sensitive_asked.what: Asks child birth certificate/NRIC number or parent NRIC/DOB
